notes: On 25 April 2025, hundreds of local residents, including tribal shaykhs and members of various tribes, protested at Al Shuhada' Square in Al Midaina city (Al Basrah). They called on the governor of Al Basrah to intervene and provide services, giving him a one-week deadline and arguing that he had not visited their area since 2017.
